extras: Operates entirely locally; includes built-in Chinese localization for the top 150 community plugins.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that makes the plugin settings sidebar your own: attach notes, group entries with icons, and jump straight to any plugin's settings.
problem: The default plugin settings sidebar lacks customization, organization, and quick access features for users managing many extensions.
summary: A UI optimization plugin that personalizes the plugin settings sidebar by allowing users to attach notes, group entries with custom icons, and provide quick access to settings.
